multiprocess_dataset: binarize a text dataset file into an indexed dataset using multiple worker processes
binarize_line_vocabulary: binarize a single text line into a tensor using a vocabulary dictionary and tokenizer
binarize_line_alignment: binarize a single alignment line into a tensor using a custom alignment parser
legacy_binarize: binarize a text file using a legacy dictionary and feed results to a consumer callback
binarize_summary_merge: merge two binarization summary objects to combine sequence counts and token replacement stats
